item: Offline stoplist batch tool: evidence and refusals for a decided word list (R111 step T1)
status: shipped (not yet run on a real keyword log)
summary: A maintainer-side, offline tool that checks a decided stopword list against a diagnostics keyword log and refuses words that would hide signal (ring members, platform names, live keywords in other languages, entities, single-source boilerplate, phrases); it writes a batch into configs/stopwords_extra only with --apply, which needs the triage thread's verdict file (only a reproducible high-confidence N is admitted) and records the log and verdict hashes in the batch comment; the platform guard stops the tool if its keep-file is missing. No stoplist file changed.
